create_PrependDataset: create a PrependDataset wrapper that prepends a token index to each item in a dataset
build_PrependDataset_with_getter: build a PrependDataset using a callable prepend_getter to determine which token index to prepend per item
test_PrependDataset_getitem: test the PrependDataset __getitem__ method to verify it correctly replaces the first token of each item
review_PrependDataset_ensure_first_token: review the PrependDataset ensure_first_token_is parameter to validate the first token matches an expected value
summarize_PrependDataset: summarize the PrependDataset class that wraps a dataset and prepends a token index to each item via a getter function
